title: Gauge Theory of Gravity and the AdS/CFT Correspondence
summary: We discuss the AdS/CFT correspondence from the viewpoint of the gauge-theoretic formulation of gravity, in which gravity is interpreted as a broken phase of conformal gauge symmetry. In the AdS$_2$/CFT$_1$ case, we show that the Schwarzian derivative naturally emerges from the boundary extrinsic curvature of AdS$_2$ geometry. The relation between the bulk Liouville geometry and the boundary projective structure is clarified.
